description: 20 configurable bug-fixing scenarios. Replace repository_url and tailor each case to defects that actually exist in the selected benchmark repository before running.

cases.title: Null input handling
cases.task_description: Fix a crash when the application receives an empty or null request payload. Return a clear validation error and add a regression test.
cases.acceptance_criteria: A null or empty payload is rejected safely; a regression test covers it.

cases.title: Missing resource handling
cases.task_description: Fix an endpoint that raises an unhandled exception when a requested resource does not exist.
cases.acceptance_criteria: The endpoint returns the documented not-found response; add a regression test.

cases.title: Invalid identifier validation
cases.task_description: Fix handling of malformed identifiers so invalid input is rejected before database access.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Malformed identifiers return a validation error and do not trigger database queries.

cases.title: Pagination boundary
cases.task_description: Fix pagination when limit is zero, negative, or larger than the supported maximum.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Pagination inputs are validated and boundary tests pass.

cases.title: Duplicate record creation
cases.task_description: Prevent duplicate records when the same create request is submitted twice.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Duplicate behavior is deterministic and covered by tests.

cases.title: Incorrect status transition
cases.task_description: Prevent a resource from moving from a terminal status back into an active status.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Invalid transitions are rejected and valid transitions remain supported.

cases.title: Timezone comparison
cases.task_description: Fix comparisons between timezone-aware and timezone-naive timestamps.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Timestamp comparisons are timezone-safe and regression-tested.

cases.title: File path traversal
cases.task_description: Prevent user-controlled paths from reading or writing outside the configured workspace.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Traversal attempts are rejected; normal workspace paths continue to work.

cases.title: Unsafe archive extraction
cases.task_description: Prevent archive entries from escaping the extraction directory.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Archive extraction validates resolved paths and includes traversal tests.

cases.title: Subprocess timeout
cases.task_description: Ensure a long-running subprocess is terminated when its configured timeout expires.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Timed-out processes are stopped and the caller receives a controlled timeout result.

cases.title: HTTP retry behavior
cases.task_description: Fix retry behavior so non-retryable client errors are not retried indefinitely.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Only configured transient failures are retried, with a finite attempt count.

cases.title: Database transaction rollback
cases.task_description: Ensure a failed multi-step write rolls back all partial database changes.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Failure leaves no partial records and a regression test verifies rollback.

cases.title: Concurrent update conflict
cases.task_description: Prevent lost updates when two requests modify the same record concurrently.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Conflicting updates are detected or safely serialized and tested.

cases.title: Secret leakage in logs
cases.task_description: Remove credentials and sensitive tokens from application log messages and error responses.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Logs and responses do not contain test secrets; add a redaction test.

cases.title: Missing authorization check
cases.task_description: Ensure users cannot read or modify resources owned by another user.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Cross-user access is denied and ownership tests cover read and write paths.

cases.title: JSON serialization failure
cases.task_description: Fix serialization of UUID, datetime, and enum values in API responses.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Responses serialize supported values consistently and endpoint tests pass.

cases.title: Empty collection edge case
cases.task_description: Fix aggregation logic that crashes or returns incorrect values for an empty collection.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Empty collections return a valid neutral result and are regression-tested.

cases.title: Unicode handling
cases.task_description: Fix text processing that corrupts or rejects valid non-ASCII input.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Unicode input is preserved correctly and tests cover multi-byte characters.

cases.title: Resource cleanup
cases.task_description: Ensure database sessions, files, or subprocess handles are released after exceptions.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Resources are cleaned up on success and failure; tests verify cleanup.

cases.title: Configuration validation
cases.task_description: Fail fast with a clear configuration error when a required setting is invalid or missing.
cases.acceptance_criteria: Invalid configuration is reported clearly without exposing secret values.
